subject: Copywriting
title: Choice Overload Paralysis
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Choice Overload Paralysis.

hook.text: Sheena Iyengar's jam study: 24 flavors attracted crowds but sold 3%. Six flavors attracted fewer but sold 30%.

buildup.text: Too many options paralyze decision-making. Copy that presents 3 clear choices outsells pages with 20.

discovery.text: Apple's product page: one product, one hero shot, one CTA. Simplicity isn't lazy—it's strategic.

twist.text: Paradoxically, people SAY they want more options. But when given them, they buy less. Surveys lie; behavior reveals.

climax.text: The copywriter's job isn't just to persuade. It's to simplify. Remove choices to increase conversions.

punchline.text: Fewer choices, more sales. Simplicity converts.

quiz.question: What happened in Iyengar's jam study with fewer choices?
